description: Every NTHF combination and what exists for it (scripts/encyclopedia-index.py; docs/shot-encyclopedia.md).

moves.name: Edwallskyffel lang
moves.description: Right wing carries the puck forward in the slot with the heel groove and passes in to the center, who shoots into the left corner

moves.name: Spade
moves.description: Right wing and center stand at the very back of the slot, and the right wing passes in to the center, who shoots directly into the left corner

moves.name: Spjass
moves.description: Center starts with the puck in the heel groove, passes with the blade a few centimeters out to the left, spins all the way around and shoots with the blade into the left corner

moves.name: Edwall-innspill
moves.description: Right wing carries the puck forward in the slot with the heel groove and sends it in to the center

moves.name: Hjerpefinte
moves.description: Center starts with the puck out on the blade to the right of the slot, and shoots directly into the right corner. Only works against a goalie expecting a Hjerpe

moves.name: Lindahl-innspill
moves.description: Right wing carries the puck forward in the slot with the stick groove and sends it in to the center

moves.name: Sørenfinte
moves.description: Center starts with the puck out on the blade to the left of the slot and shoots directly into the left corner. Only works against a goalie expecting a Søren

moves.name: Direkteskudd
moves.description: Right wing shoots directly into the goal, preferably lifting it into the top corner

moves.name: Fakie Forulemping
moves.description: Right wing starts behind the opponent's goal, carries the puck backward in the slot and shoots between the goalie and the right post

moves.name: Lillstøvel
moves.description: Center starts with the puck in the toe groove, passes with the toe a few centimeters out to the left, and shoots with the blade into the left corner. Named after the legendary Djurgården player Carl-Göran 'Lill-Stöveln' Öberg, younger brother of Hans 'Stöveln' Öberg

moves.name: Maltzev / Smygar
moves.description: Right wing carries the puck forward in the slot and shoots into the goal between the goalie and the right post

moves.name: Bedehus-Smygar / Tysk Smygar
moves.description: Right wing carries the puck forward in the slot and shoots into the goal via the goalie's back

moves.name: EMoe-smyger
moves.description: Right wing carries the puck in the outer stick groove forward in the slot and shoots into the goal in motion

moves.name: Edwallskyffel kort
moves.description: Right wing carries the puck forward in the slot with the heel groove and passes in to the center, who shoots into the right corner

moves.name: Hagerup
moves.description: Right wing and center stand at the very back of the slot, and the right wing passes in to the center, who shoots directly into the right corner

moves.name: Hælskyffel kort
moves.description: Right wing carries the puck backward in the slot with the stick groove and passes in with the heel to the center, who shoots into the right corner. Can also be performed with a blade pass

moves.name: Hælskyffel lang
moves.description: Right wing carries the puck backward in the slot with the stick groove and passes in with the heel to the center, who shoots into the left corner. Can also be performed with a blade pass

moves.name: Invers Smygero / Eidsneskølle
moves.description: Right wing carries the puck quickly backward along the boards, goes past the puck and shoots with a set blade into the goal

moves.name: Lindahlskyffel kort
moves.description: Right wing carries the puck forward in the slot and passes in to the center, who shoots into the right corner

moves.name: Lindahlskyffel lang
moves.description: Right wing carries the puck forward in the slot and passes in to the center, who shoots into the left corner

moves.name: Nuttunenslegga
moves.description: Right wing carries the puck backward in the slot, stops and shoots directly into the nearest top corner over the goalie's stick

moves.name: Näcka
moves.description: Center starts with the puck in the heel groove, passes with the heel a few centimeters out to the right, and shoots with the blade into the right corner

moves.name: Truls
moves.description: Right wing carries the puck on the outside of the blade backward and passes in to the center, who scores

moves.name: Fakie Lillstøvel
moves.description: Center starts with the puck in the heel groove, quickly shifts to having the puck in the toe groove, and performs a Lillstøvel

moves.name: Gangsøyskyffel kort
moves.description: Right wing carries the puck quickly backward along the boards, spins around counterclockwise and passes in to the center, who shoots into the right corner

moves.name: Gangsøyskyffel lang
moves.description: Right wing carries the puck quickly backward along the boards, spins around counterclockwise and passes in to the center, who shoots into the left corner

moves.name: Lillhæl
moves.description: Center starts with the puck in the heel groove, passes with the blade about one centimeter out to the left, and shoots with the heel into the left corner

moves.name: Lillstøvelfinte / C 29
moves.description: Center performs a Lillstøvel, but places the puck in the right corner. Only works against a reacting goalie

moves.name: Lønnskipp
moves.description: The puck lies near the right wing, who shoots directly into the top corner with lift

moves.name: Omvendspjass
moves.description: Center starts with the puck in the toe groove, passes with the blade a few centimeters out to the right, spins all the way around and shoots with the blade into the right corner

moves.name: Snik
moves.description: Right wing shoots the puck via the goalie to the center, who shoots directly into the goal

moves.name: Snok / Mexikaner
moves.description: Right wing shoots the puck via the boards to the center, who shoots directly into the goal

moves.name: Tryykari kort
moves.description: Right wing carries the puck quickly forward in the slot with the heel groove (Edwall drag), stops and performs a heel shovel into the near corner

moves.name: Tryykari lang
moves.description: Right wing carries the puck quickly forward in the slot with the heel groove (Edwall drag), stops and performs a heel shovel into the far corner

moves.name: Tryykarifinte
moves.description: Right wing carries the puck quickly forward in the slot with the heel groove (Edwall drag), stops before the goal line, turns 180 degrees counterclockwise and shoots with the heel into the goal

moves.name: Veggskyffel
moves.description: Right wing stands far forward in the slot with the puck and shoots via the right boards to the center, who scores

moves.name: Agdur
moves.description: Pass from center to left wing, back to the center and into the right corner

moves.name: Fakie Agdur
moves.description: Pass from center to right wing, back to the center and into the left corner

moves.name: Fakie Harlem Shuffle
moves.description: Right wing passes to the center, who with a swinging blade flicks the puck into the goal

moves.name: Fakie Jon Spesial / Korabel
moves.description: Right wing shoots via the blade of a stationary center and into the left corner of the goal

moves.name: Fakie Karusell
moves.description: Pass from the right wing along the boards behind the goal to the left wing, who passes in to the center, who scores

moves.name: Fakie Näcka
moves.description: Center starts with the puck in the toe groove, quickly shifts to having the puck in the heel groove, and performs a Näcka

moves.name: Fakie Omvendspjass
moves.description: Center starts with the puck in the heel groove, quickly shifts to having the puck in the toe groove, and performs an Omvendspjass

moves.name: Fakie Spjass
moves.description: Center starts with the puck in the toe groove, quickly shifts to having the puck in the heel groove, and performs a Spjass

moves.name: Fakie Tomahawk
moves.description: Right wing shoots via the left boards and into the goal

moves.name: Fakie Veggdyr
moves.description: Center shoots the puck from the toe groove via the right boards, back to the center and into the goal

moves.name: Fakie Velodrom
moves.description: Pass from the right wing along the boards behind the goal to the left wing, who shoots into the left corner

moves.name: Fakie kniv
moves.description: Pass from right wing to the right defenseman, who shoots directly into the goal

moves.name: Fakie lang-kniv
moves.description: Pass from right wing to the left defenseman, who shoots directly into the goal

moves.name: Furious G
moves.description: Smygero with a pass to the center, who scores

moves.name: Hjerpe
moves.description: Center starts with the puck out on the blade to the right of the slot, carries the puck over to the left side of the slot, and shoots into the left corner

moves.name: Langorv
moves.description: Pass from right wing along the boards behind the goal so that the puck ends up with the left defenseman, who shoots directly into the goal

moves.name: Nuttunen
moves.description: Pass from right wing to the left defenseman and on to the center, who scores from far back in the slot

moves.name: Nuttunen goes useless
moves.description: Pass from right wing to the center far back in the slot, who flicks it on to the left defenseman, who shoots directly into the goal

moves.name: Näckafinte
moves.description: Center performs a Näcka, but places the puck in the left corner. Only works against a reacting goalie

moves.name: Omvendspjassfinte
moves.description: Center performs an Omvendspjass, but places the puck in the left corner. Only works against a reacting goalie

moves.name: Pettersonskyffel
moves.description: Right wing carries the puck forward in the slot, goes slightly past the puck, spins clockwise and passes in to the center, who scores

moves.name: Senter-Ceuleman
moves.description: Center shoots the puck from the toe groove via the right boards and into the goal behind (or via) the goalie

moves.name: Senter-Rokkade
moves.description: Pass from center to the right defenseman and on to the left defenseman, who shoots one-timed into the goal

moves.name: Silis-innspill
moves.description: Right wing carries the puck quickly backward in the slot with the heel groove and sends it in to the center in motion

moves.name: Smygero
moves.description: Right wing carries the puck quickly forward along the boards and flicks the puck into the goal between the goalie and the right post

moves.name: Spjassfinte
moves.description: Center performs a Spjass, but places the puck in the right corner. Only works against a reacting goalie

moves.name: Søren
moves.description: Center starts with the puck out on the blade to the left of the slot, carries the puck over to the right side of the slot, and shoots into the right corner. Named after the legendary table hockey and ice hockey player Sören Johansson, who did a similar feint in ice hockey

moves.name: Tomahawk
moves.description: Right wing stands far back in the slot and shoots via the right boards and into the goal

moves.name: Tønsbergslegga
moves.description: Right wing carries the puck forward in the slot, passes it a few centimeters to the left, spins around and shoots into the goal in motion

moves.name: Veggdyr
moves.description: Center shoots the puck from the heel groove via the left boards, back to the center and into the goal

moves.name: Wilkens
moves.description: Right wing pretends to drag the puck backward, stops, and passes in forward to the center, who scores

moves.name: Østerman-innspill
moves.description: Right wing carries the puck quickly forward in the slot, turns 180 degrees counterclockwise, stops, spins back and sends the puck in to the center

moves.name: Agduro
moves.description: Pass from center to left wing, who carries the puck backward in the slot and passes behind the opponent's center back to their own center at the very back of the slot and into the goal (see Sentrifugo)

moves.name: Brustadbu
moves.description: Right wing scores with a kiosk shot

moves.name: Fakie Gutshot
moves.description: Pass from right wing to the goalie, who shoots directly into the goal

moves.name: Fakie Halv-Agdur
moves.description: Pass from center to right wing, who shoots directly into the goal

moves.name: Fakie Horvath
moves.description: Center shoots into the right boards behind the opponent's goal, gets the rebound, and shoots into the left corner

moves.name: Fakie Invers Agduro
moves.description: Center carries the puck backward in the slot and passes behind the opponent's left defenseman to the right wing, who carries the puck forward in the slot and passes in front of the opponent's left defenseman back to the center and into the goal

moves.name: Fakie Invers Halv-Agduro
moves.description: Center carries the puck backward in the slot and passes behind the opponent's left defenseman to the right wing, who shoots directly into the goal

moves.name: Fakie Invers Kano
moves.description: Pass from center via the left boards to the left defenseman, who shoots one-timed into the goal

moves.name: Fakie Senter-Ceuleman
moves.description: Center shoots the puck from the heel groove via the left boards and into the goal behind (or via) the goalie

moves.name: Fakie Senter-Karusell
moves.description: Center passes to the right wing, who sends the puck in a Velodrom over to the left wing and in to the center and into the goal

moves.name: Fakie Senter-Rokkade
moves.description: Pass from center to the left defenseman and on to the right defenseman, who shoots one-timed into the goal

moves.name: Fakie Senter-Velodrom
moves.description: Center passes to the right wing, who sends the puck in a Velodrom over to the left wing, who shoots directly into the left corner

moves.name: Fakie Senterkniv
moves.description: Pass from center to the right defenseman, who shoots one-timed into the goal

moves.name: Fakie Zorro
moves.description: Pass from right wing to center, on to the right defenseman, and finally to the left defenseman, who shoots directly into the goal

moves.name: Gretzky
moves.description: Pass from right wing along the boards behind the goal to the left wing, who sends it backward to the center, who scores

moves.name: Halv-Agdur
moves.description: Pass from center to left wing, who shoots directly into the left corner

moves.name: Horvath
moves.description: Center starts with the puck a bit out on the blade to the right of the slot, shoots into the left rounded boards, gets the rebound, and shoots into the right corner

moves.name: Invers Kano
moves.description: Pass from center via the right boards to the right defenseman, who shoots one-timed into the goal

moves.name: Invers Kryssar
moves.description: Pass from right wing to left wing, who shoots into the left corner

moves.name: Invers Kryssar med Karusell
moves.description: Pass from right wing to left wing, who passes along the boards behind the goal to the right wing, who sends it in to the center, who scores

moves.name: Invers Kryssar med Velodrom
moves.description: Pass from right wing to left wing, who passes along the boards behind the goal to the right wing, who shoots directly into the goal

moves.name: Invers Kryssar med innspill
moves.description: Pass from right wing to left wing, who sends it on to the center, who scores

moves.name: Invers Rookierokkade
moves.description: Pass from right wing far back in the slot to the right defenseman, who sends it back to the right wing, who scores

moves.name: Marcus Andersson
moves.description: Right shovel directly into the right corner

moves.name: Newton
moves.description: Center shoots via the opponent's right defenseman and into the goal

moves.name: Rambokniv
moves.description: Pass from center to the left defenseman, who passes behind the opponent's center and in to their own center, who shoots one-timed from the very back of the slot

moves.name: Reiersen
moves.description: Pass from right wing along the right boards behind their own goal to the left defenseman, who shoots directly into the goal

moves.name: Senter-Karusell
moves.description: Center passes to the left wing, who sends the puck in a Velodrom over to the right wing and in to the center and into the goal

moves.name: Senter-Velodrom
moves.description: Center passes to the left wing, who sends the puck in a Velodrom over to the right wing, who shoots directly into the right corner

moves.name: Senterkniv
moves.description: Pass from center to the left defenseman, who shoots one-timed into the goal

moves.name: Senterknivo
moves.description: Pass from center behind the opponent's center to the left defenseman, who shoots one-timed into the goal

moves.name: Bacalao
moves.description: Pass from center to the right defenseman, who shoots one-timed via the right boards and into the goal

moves.name: Burkgurk
moves.description: Pass from right wing along the boards behind their own goal to the left wing, who flicks directly into the left corner

moves.name: Burkgurkskyffel
moves.description: Pass from right wing along the boards behind their own goal to the left wing, who sends it on to the center, who scores

moves.name: Fakie Gutshot-Hansen
moves.description: Pass from right wing to the goalie, who sends it back to the right wing, who shoots into the right corner

moves.name: Fakie Lang-Agdur
moves.description: Pass from right wing to left wing, who sends it back to the right wing, who shoots directly into the goal

moves.name: Fakie Mors Kök / Fars Kök
moves.description: Pass from right wing at the very front of the slot via the left rounded boards to the center, who scores

moves.name: General Reiersen
moves.description: Pass from center along the right boards behind their own goal to the left defenseman, who shoots one-timed into the goal

moves.name: Holmin
moves.description: Center shoots into the boards at the start of the right rounded boards, so that the puck glides along the boards to the left wing, who shoots directly into the goal

moves.name: Holms
moves.description: Center shoots into the boards at the start of the right rounded boards, so that the puck glides along the boards to the left wing and on to the center, who shoots directly into the goal

moves.name: Holms-Gretzky
moves.description: Center shoots into the boards at the start of the right rounded boards, so that the puck glides along the boards to the left wing, who is placed just to the left of the opponent's goal and passes backward to the center, who shoots directly into the goal

moves.name: Invers Agduro
moves.description: Center carries the puck backward in the slot and passes behind the opponent's center to the left wing, who passes back to the center and into the goal

moves.name: Invers Halv-Agduro
moves.description: Center carries the puck backward in the slot and passes behind the opponent's center to the left wing, who shoots directly into the left corner

moves.name: Lille Trille
moves.description: Right wing scores with a weak kiosk shot that rolls into the left corner

moves.name: Senter-Backnäcka
moves.description: Pass from center to the right defenseman, who shoots around the opponent's left defenseman and into the goal (see Backnäcka)

moves.name: Senterkiosk
moves.description: Center starts with the puck a couple of centimeters to the left of the slot and performs a Kiosk into the left or right top corner

moves.name: Spjass-Horvath
moves.description: Center performs a Spjass, deliberately misses the goal and hits the left rounded boards, gets the rebound, and shoots into the right corner

moves.name: Jorda Rundt
moves.description: Pass from right wing along the boards behind their own goal and all the way around back to the right wing, who shoots directly into the goal

moves.name: Jorda Rundt-skyffel
moves.description: Pass from right wing along the boards behind their own goal and all the way around back to the right wing, who sends it to the center, who scores

moves.name: Mission Impossible 2
moves.description: Right wing sends the puck along the boards to the left wing, who sends it directly to the center, who scores

moves.name: Mission Impossible 3
moves.description: Center plays the puck off the goal frame and puts the rebound into the goal

moves.name: Reiersen på bærtur
moves.description: Pass from right wing along the right boards behind their own goal to the left defenseman, who sends it behind their own goal to the right defenseman, who shoots directly into the goal

moves.name: Skalpell
moves.description: Pass from center to the goalie, who shoots one-timed into the goal
